brief:
Israeli soldiers shot and wounded several Palestinians and abducted multiple residents during military operations across the occupied West Bank on Tuesday, IMEMC News reported. The incidents took place across multiple locations during what the outlet characterized as military invasions throughout the territory.

Israeli authorities also issued a land seizure order in the northern Jordan Valley as troops conducted the operations. The military sweeps resulted in casualties and detentions, though specific information on the number of wounded Palestinians and the identities of those taken into custody remained unclear.
